_about: Known defective or doubtful tests of autogen_01 and autogen_02 (roadmap step 1, 2026-09-27; updated in step 3 the same day). A scenario's entry covers every test derived from it. `for_new_agents` (the name is historical) is the action for every agent's results: by the decision 'flawed is flawed', a test to leave out is left out of all results, Qwen's recorded ones included, and counted as flawed in the generation numbers; when it was found is a footnote. 'Weak but valid' tests are kept. This list is also the start of the failure-attribution development set (roadmap step 5).

curated.note: 'Hide' acts on the actor's calendar list; the second intended match is not on it.
'Invite' presupposes a channel that is not archived; the freed archived channel is no reasonable match.
'Hide' excludes a calendar that is already hidden, which the variant frees.

curated.kind: test: doubt, not a defect by the search's test
curated.note: Counts the primary calendar as a match of 'hide', which Google's interface may not offer.

'Unarchive the incidents channel about the checkout outage': the near miss left is a live channel, which the verb rules out. Valid, but the near miss is no real trap; 'it is already unarchived' is a correct absence report (the judge called one such trial presented).
'Exactly four members' depends on counting the acting bot. The PI ruled that the bot counts, as the writer and Slack's API count it.
Left out of every run by the pre-run review rule.
Removing the target removes the milestone the near miss's issue pointed to, so the probe cannot expose R:ProjectMilestone.projectId. Since roadmap step 3 the derivation drops it.
curated.for_new_agents: leave out (the derivation drops it since roadmap step 3)

curated.kind: scenario: depends on the run date
curated.note: 'Overdue' is relative to a today nothing sets; the scenario assumes 2026-09-30. After 2026-09-30 a near miss becomes a second match. Valid for runs up to that date (roadmap step 3).
curated.for_new_agents: keep for runs up to 2026-09-30; leave out its tests after

curated.kind: scenario: seed contradicted the request (fixed in roadmap step 3)
curated.note: Every event carried a Los Angeles time zone, even on the New-York-time calendar; an agent that read the events' zones saw no New York calendar. Since roadmap step 3 events take their calendar's zone, and the rebuilt suite has the fixed seed.
curated.for_new_agents: leave out the recorded runs (old seed); keep the rebuilt suite

curated.note: 'the PDF in the Finance Reports folder owned by Maya Chen' lets 'owned by' attach to the folder. The PI ruled it valid (roadmap step 3): natural ambiguity is the agent's to resolve, and a misreading that exposes a fact counts.
The transparency condition is written as an aside; one near miss is contestable.
Contrived: a Slack user named by email, and 'that a bot reacted to with tada'.
One near miss has implausible data (created June 8, last modified June 5).
'(not in its subfolders)' is a hint only a test would give; it hands away the H:Folder.parent_id near miss.
'posted at 12:40', added to fix a superlative, makes 'latest' redundant.
